newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Equity Res estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Equity Res estimates raised.

text.p: - EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it raised its estimates for funds from operations for Equity Residential Properties Trust to $3.59 a share in 1997 from $3.55 and to $3.94 a share in 1998 from $3.85.
- EVEREN said it remains confident in the overall stability of the multifamily apartment market and Equity Residential's ability to sustain its acquisition program.
- EVEREN said it expects Equity Residential to acquire about $550 million in additional property in 1997, in addition to previously announced acquisitions.
- EVEREN said it also raised its six-month price target for Equity Residential to $50 a share from $45.50, and increased its 18-month target to $52.50 from $47.50.
- Shares of Equity traded off 5/8 at 47-1/4.
